title: Search Result
description: One web search hit collected while executing a SearchPlan's queries (see search_plan.schema.json). This is raw search-provider output, structured and deduplicated — not an extracted sports result (see result_record.schema.json for that, which this step does not populate).
$comment: title and url are preserved exactly as the search provider returned them — never reformatted, translated, or 'corrected'. snippet is null when the provider didn't supply one for this result; it is never synthesized from other text, since that would misattribute invented wording to a specific URL.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the result conforms to. Optional; assumed current if omitted.

title.description: Exactly as returned by the search provider.

url.description: Exactly as returned by the search provider — never normalized, canonicalized, or rewritten. Deduplication is keyed on exact string equality of this field.

snippet.description: The provider's description/snippet for this specific result, if it supplied one. Null when it didn't — never invented or borrowed from a synthesized overall answer, since that could misattribute wording to a URL that never carried it.

query_used.description: Every query (from the SearchPlan) that surfaced this exact URL. More than one entry means multiple query phrasings converged on the same page — that's why this is a list rather than a single string.

domain.description: Hostname parsed from 'url' (lowercased), e.g. 'en.wikipedia.org'. Derived mechanically, not supplied by the provider — used to see at a glance which distinct sites are represented, never to merge or drop results.

provider.description: Which search backend produced this result, e.g. 'claude_web_search'. Kept per-result (not just once per run) so provenance survives even if results are later filtered/reordered.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this result was collected.
